# PDFTrail

> PDFTrail is a macOS app (with an iOS companion) that converts PDFs to Excel (.xlsx), Word (.docx), Markdown, CSV, and JSON entirely on-device. Born-digital PDFs are read directly from the file's text layer — no OCR guessing; scanned PDFs use on-device OCR with a review step before export. No account, no sign-up, no cloud uploads. Free to try; $24 one-time unlock, no subscription. Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6799649606

## Guides

- [How to Convert a Bank Statement PDF to Excel on Mac](https://pdftrail.app/blog/convert-bank-statement-pdf-to-excel-mac/): The three real options on a Mac (manual, online converters, on-device conversion), why bank statements should never be uploaded to online converters, and a step-by-step on-device walkthrough.

## News and engine notes

- [PDFTrail 1.2: Real Excel Tables from Scanned Pages](https://pdftrail.app/blog/pdftrail-1-2/): Release notes — scanned tables exported with page-true structure, OCR inside embedded images, combined Word export fix, 10 free exports per format.
- [Before and After: Teaching Our Engine to Read Bad Scans](https://pdftrail.app/blog/teaching-the-engine-to-read-bad-scans/): How the engine went from inventing 26 phantom tables on noise pages to zero, the fabrication-never-buys-recall rule, and the conversion report that replaces silent page skips.
